places.name: Market Square (Markt) & Belfry Tower
places.ai_summary: The Market Square is the heart of Bruges, featuring the iconic Belfry Tower. Visitors can enjoy horse-drawn carriage rides, explore the medieval architecture, and climb the Belfry for panoramic views.

opening_hours.notes: Belfry Tower hours may vary during holidays.

places.place_tip: Climb the Belfry Tower for stunning views of Bruges.

places.name: Burg Square & City Hall
places.ai_summary: Burg Square is a historic square in Bruges, home to the City Hall and Basilica of the Holy Blood. The square showcases stunning Gothic architecture and offers a glimpse into Bruges' rich history.

opening_hours.notes: City Hall hours may vary during events.

places.place_tip: Visit the Basilica of the Holy Blood located in the square.

places.name: Canal Cruise
places.ai_summary: A canal cruise in Bruges offers a unique perspective of the city’s medieval architecture and charming bridges. It's a relaxing way to explore Bruges' historic center, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

opening_hours.notes: Last cruise departs at 17:00. Hours may vary in winter.

places.place_tip: Book your tickets online to avoid long queues.

places.name: Church of Our Lady (Madonna by Michelangelo)
places.ai_summary: The Church of Our Lady in Bruges is famous for Michelangelo's sculpture of Madonna and Child. The church features stunning brick Gothic architecture and houses several other important artworks.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on January 1st and December 25th.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful altar and the tombs of Charles the Bold and Mary of Burgundy.

places.name: Groeningemuseum (Flemish Art)
places.ai_summary: The Groeningemuseum is home to an impressive collection of Flemish Primitive and Renaissance art, including works by Jan van Eyck and Hans Memling. The museum itself is a beautiful example of Gothic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on January 1st and December 25th.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique art prints and souvenirs.

places.name: Rozenhoedkaai Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: Rozenhoedkaai is one of the most photographed spots in Bruges, known for its picturesque canal view and historic buildings. It's the perfect place to capture the essence of Bruges.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon for the best light.

places.place_tip: Visit at sunrise or sunset for breathtaking views and photos.

places.name: Minnewater Lake (Lake of Love)
places.ai_summary: Minnewater Lake, also known as the Lake of Love, is a tranquil spot in Bruges, perfect for a romantic stroll or a peaceful break from sightseeing. The lake is surrounded by beautiful trees and historic buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Take a walk around the lake and enjoy the serene views.

places.name: Beguinage (Begijnhof)
places.ai_summary: The Beguinage is a serene complex in Bruges, once home to the Beguines, a group of religious women. The site includes a beautiful courtyard, church, and museum, offering a glimpse into the life of the Beguines.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on January 1st and December 25th.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum to learn about the history of the Beguines.

places.name: Choco-Story Chocolate Museum
places.ai_summary: Choco-Story is a museum dedicated to chocolate, detailing its history and production. Visitors can enjoy interactive exhibits and chocolate tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 16:00.

places.place_tip: Join a chocolate-making workshop for a fun and tasty experience.

places.name: De Halve Maan Brewery
places.ai_summary: De Halve Maan is a historic brewery in Bruges, known for its Belgian ales. Visitors can take a guided tour to learn about the brewing process and enjoy beer tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Last tour starts at 17:00.

places.place_tip: Try the Brugse Zot, a local beer, at the end of the tour.

attribution.title: Belgium-5940 - Provincial Court (13746435813)
attribution.author: Dennis G. Jarvis
attribution.description: The Provincial Court is the best example of how Bruges was renovated in neo-gothic style during the second half of the 19th century. After the destruction of the water halls in 1787 a new complex of houses was built in classicist style. This style was considered very modern in a town that was basically built in late-gothic style. In 1850 the provincial government bought the complex, enlarged it and made it the seat of the provincial institutions. The members of the catholic and traditionalist political parties rejected the building as 'unfit for the beautiful gothic Bruges'. In 1878 a fire destroyed most of the building. Different groups took their chance to have it reconstructed in neo-gothic style, the 'house'-style of the catholic party. On the left side of the complex is now the house of the Governor of the Province of West-Flanders. The red brick building on the right side is the Post Office of Bruges.

places.name: Saint John’s Hospital Museum
places.ai_summary: Saint John's Hospital is a former medieval hospital, now a museum showcasing the history of healthcare in Bruges. The museum features ancient surgical instruments, apothecary jars, and artworks.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on January 1st and December 25th.

places.place_tip: Explore the tranquil cloisters and the impressive art collection.

places.name: Windmills of Bruges (Kruisvest)
places.ai_summary: The Windmills of Bruges, located on the city’s ramparts, are a group of historic windmills that offer panoramic views of the city and its surroundings. They are a symbol of Bruges' medieval industrial power.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on January 1st and December 25th.

places.place_tip: Visit the windmills for a unique perspective of Bruges' medieval architecture.

places.name: Jan van Eyck Square
places.ai_summary: Jan van Eyck Square is a charming square in Bruges, named after the famous painter Jan van Eyck. The square is surrounded by historic buildings and features a statue of the painter.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Take a moment to relax on a bench and enjoy the view of the square.

places.name: Belfry Climb (366 Steps)
places.ai_summary: The Belfry of Bruges is a medieval bell tower with a climb of 366 steps leading to a panoramic viewing platform. The climb offers breathtaking views of Bruges and the surrounding countryside.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 17:00. Hours may vary in winter.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the climb and enjoy the views from the top.

places.name: Frietmuseum (Fries Museum)
places.ai_summary: The Frietmuseum is dedicated to the Belgian fry, showcasing the history and culture of this beloved snack. Visitors can enjoy interactive exhibits and, of course, tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 17:00.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to taste authentic Belgian fries with various sauces.

places.name: Bruges City Theatre
places.ai_summary: The Bruges City Theatre is a historic theatre offering a variety of performances, including drama, music, and dance. The theatre itself is an architectural gem worth visiting.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performance times.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

places.name: Sint-Salvator Cathedral
places.ai_summary: Sint-Salvator Cathedral is the oldest parish church in Bruges, featuring a mix of architectural styles. The cathedral is known for its impressive organ and beautiful stained glass windows.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on January 1st and December 25th.

places.place_tip: Attend a concert or organ recital for a memorable experience.

places.name: Historium Virtual Reality Tour
places.ai_summary: The Historium offers a unique virtual reality experience that takes you back to medieval Bruges. The tour includes interactive exhibits and a VR ride.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 16:00.

places.place_tip: Wear the VR headset for an immersive experience.

places.name: Boat Ride through Canals
places.ai_summary: A boat ride through the canals of Bruges is a must-do activity, offering a unique view of the city’s historic buildings and bridges. Several companies offer guided tours.

opening_hours.notes: Last boat departs at 17:00. Hours may vary in winter.

places.place_tip: Listen to the guide's commentary to learn interesting facts about Bruges.

places.name: Brouwerij Fort Lapin
places.ai_summary: Brouwerij Fort Lapin is a brewery located in a former fort, offering a range of craft beers. The brewery provides guided tours and tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for tour times.

places.place_tip: Try the unique beers brewed on-site.
